cases.description: What a value carries is data: a placeholder it spells opens nothing, and the key that placeholder names is never read.
One walk resolves every placeholder the message writes and reads nothing it emitted, so the same text is syntax where the message spells it and data where a value carries it.
A message a host wrote as a plain object reaches the walk as its serialization, and is parsed and unescaped like any other.
A message a host wrote as an array is unescaped like any other, so the backslash its serialization doubled is single in the output.
Escape sequences are removed from the message's own text and from nothing else, so a backslash a value carries stands for itself and an escaped pair it carries is not one.
A value is never unescaped, so every backslash it carries reaches the output, doubled ones included.
An escaped pair the message writes is text and loses its escapes once; the same pair a value carries is data and reaches the output as it stands.
A payload default is a value like any other, so it is not unescaped.
A placeholder a value carries is never resolved, and the key it names is never read.
What an option value resolves to reaches the output as it stands, so a brace it contributes stands beside the message's own text and opens nothing.
What an inline default resolves to reaches the output as it stands, so a brace it contributes opens nothing either.
A payload default is data too, so a placeholder it carries is not resolved.
A wrapper default is data too, so a placeholder it carries is not resolved.
A wrapper default a selection falls back to is data, so a placeholder it carries is not resolved.
A placeholder in the option a modifier selects is resolved there, and its result reaches the output through the placeholder around it.
A placeholder in an option value declares options of its own, and the innermost result is what reaches the output.
A closing pair the inner placeholder's result carries closes nothing: the placeholder around it ends where the message spells it.
A construct whose value opens a placeholder that never closes does not derive, so the inner placeholder is the one that resolves and the opening pair it answers with derives nothing.
An option the modifier passes over is never rendered: the placeholder in it is not resolved and the payload entry it names is not read, so an entry no conversion can describe is not reported.
A value never becomes syntax, so text it carries cannot add a segment to the placeholder that read it or outrank the one the message spells.
